title: The Dangers of Relying Solely on Prayer for Healing

top_liked.author: @lostexplorersguild767
top_liked.text: For these “faith healers,” the loss of health, or even life, is irrelevant. The donations are the only significant concern. As long as the donations keep coming, as long as they keep profiting, to hell with the congregation. It’s a grift.

top_liked.author: @tiredofliars
top_liked.text: I am 65, my ear still bothers me from when my mother punctured my eardrum when i was three. When it was infected, and bleeding, she would PRAY for me.  When that failed, she would call the minister over, who would use holy water, sacramented oil and more prayer.  When THAT WOULD…

top_liked.author: @Polonez123-r4w
top_liked.text: I agree 100%. I relied on prayers and god for so many years instead of being defensive and more action oriented. Had I not relied so much, I would have made better decision in my life. Also prayer doesn’t work. I prayed for over 30 years for certain things to happen or not…

top_liked.author: @Beerglass1980
top_liked.text:
Two hands working can do more than a thousand clasped in prayer. 
Madeline O'Hair.
